listing.name: Naev
listing.summary: Explore space, trade and take missions in Naev. Use the official desktop package with its included game data.
listing.download_block_reason: Use Naev’s downloads page for the Windows installer, Linux AppImage or universal Mac disk image.

steps.title: Get the current official package
steps.instruction: Use the releases linked by Naev’s downloads page. Current releases are on Codeberg; the old GitHub mirror has older packages. The desktop packages include the game data. Keep the complete package and its licence notices.

steps.title: Set up Naev on your computer
steps.instruction: On Windows x64, use the installer. For a portable copy, select Portable Install and choose a separate writable folder. On Linux x64, mark the AppImage executable and open it. On Intel or Apple Silicon Mac, copy the complete Naev app from the disk image to Applications. Follow the publisher’s Mac security instructions if your system prevents opening it.

steps.title: Keep your profile before upgrading or removing files
steps.instruction: Close every copy of Naev and back up its whole profile, including conf.lua, saves and plugins. A normal Windows install uses %APPDATA%/naev. A portable Windows copy uses naev-data beside the player unless you changed datapath.lua. Linux normally uses ~/.local/share/naev, or naev under XDG_DATA_HOME. Mac normally uses ~/Library/Application Support/naev. Keep any custom data folder as well.

steps.title: Preserve older profiles before the first upgrade launch
steps.instruction: Naev 0.13 can move files from older profile locations when the new location has no matching file. Before starting an upgrade, keep copies of the existing profile and configuration folders, including an older ~/.config/naev on Linux, or ~/Library/Application Support/org.naev.Naev and ~/Library/Preferences/naev on Mac. Follow the actual profile path reported by your game.

references.title: Updates, backups and existing installations
references.instruction: Use upstream’s installer, app or package tools to replace the runtime. Keep your working version and every profile folder recoverable. When registering a prepared Windows copy in Portcove, select naev.exe and its containing folder as the working directory so an existing datapath.lua applies. Retain any established launch arguments. Removing the registration leaves external files in place. You and upstream own runtime replacement, backups, save migration and file removal.

references.title: Host requirements and other platforms
references.instruction: The publisher lists Windows 10 or newer, macOS 11 or newer for the universal app, and glibc 2.30 or newer for the Linux x64 AppImage. Naev needs a working OpenGL context. The reviewed release has no Android or Linux ARM64 package. These requirements and package listings do not establish Portcove gameplay or minimum-system qualification.
